title: Version 2026.06.30 - Clinical Velocity & Soundboard UI
content: Introduced the interactive Soundboard UI for high-precision audiometry. Launched 'Fast-Tap' THI assessments and a simplified CBT Thought Record with automated AI reframing. Integrated the System & Clinical Insights Hub into Settings for real-time performance and progress tracking.

title: Version 2026.06.27 - Enhanced Audiometry
content: Added 750 Hz frequency support to the Hearing Profile (Audiogram) for more precise clinical mapping and therapy compensation.

title: Version 2026.06.26 - Expanded Soundscapes & Presets
content: Introduced 'Forest' as a new procedural nature soundscape for enhanced relaxation. Added framework for user-generated sound presets to save and load custom therapy configurations.

title: Version 2026.06.25 - Security & Privacy Enhancements
content: Comprehensive updates to the User Manual detailing the 'Zero-Knowledge' architecture, HIPAA compliance, AI data flow, third-party library audit policies, and security update notifications. Includes a global kill-switch for AI features.

title: Version 2026.06.22 - Complete WASM DSP
content: Full migration of all noise colors (including Blue and Violet) and nature soundscapes to the high-performance WebAssembly engine for jitter-free audio.

title: Version 2026.06.19 - Stability & Performance
content: This update provides critical stability fixes for the real-time AudioWorklet engine and introduces high-performance vectorization for the offline WAV generator.

title: Version 2026.06.14 - Binaural Visualizer
content: Experience your therapy visually! A new real-time visualizer for Binaural Beats shows dual waveforms and phase relationships to confirm entrainment.

title: Version 2026.06.13 - DSP Refinements
content: Minor stability improvements and precision tuning for the Binaural visualizer connectivity.

title: Version 2026.06.12 - Neural Auto-Match
content: Therapy sounds now automatically adapt to your pitch match, selecting the most effective procedural texture (Ocean, Melody, or Zen) for your profile.

title: v2026.06.11 - Neural Melody & Harmonic Integration
content: Introduced a generative pentatonic melody engine that replaces static noise with relaxing, anchor-aware music. Intervals are derived from your tinnitus pitch.

title: v2026.06.10 - Global Pitch Synchronization
content: Reinforced the Notch Finder matched pitch as the 'Global Truth'. It now automatically propagates to Notch, CR, and Aesthetic Sound modes more robustly.

title: v2026.06.9 - UX Persistence & Symmetry
content: Resolved layout issues and clarified that certain features are hidden behind mandatory clinical safety steps.

title: v2026.06.8 - Aesthetic Soundscapes
content: Replaced static loops with dynamic, procedurally generated 'Forest Rain' and 'Ocean Surge' acoustic profiles.

title: v2026.06.5 - Neural Pulse Mode
content: Added periodic amplitude modulation (AM) to the noise engine. This 'Neural Pulse' helps disrupt temporal neural patterns.

title: v2026.06.3 - Onboarding UX & Layout
content: All therapy and utility cards are now hidden until mandatory setup is complete to ensure user focus and clinical safety.

title: v2026.06.2 - Organic Audio & Safety
content: Harmonic Wash (Zen Mode) replaces static noise with mathematically aligned harmonics. Integrated global safety flags for hearing aid users.

title: v2026.06.1 - Spectral Intelligence
content: Added real-time warnings to Notch and CR modules if your noise source doesn't cover your matched frequency.

title: v2026.05.4 - Branding & Session Entry
content: Integrated a new cinematic entry sequence featuring an animated swarm of 'tinnitus bees' orbiting a stylized ear logo.

title: Version 2026.05.3 - Clinical Alignment
content: This major update ensures the suite is 100% technically aligned with the User Manual, standardizing terminology like 'Broadband Sound Therapy'.

title: Hearing Profile (Audiogram)
content: You can now enter your professional audiogram results. The engine uses the Half-Gain Rule to automatically compensate for hearing loss in your therapy sessions.

title: Habituation Milestones
content: We've integrated an automated tracker to monitor your journey through the six clinical stages of habituation (Appendix E).

title: Global Reporting
content: You can now generate a comprehensive multi-module Progress Report (PDF) from the dashboard to share with your audiologist.

title: Q-factor & Tonality
content: A new trend chart in the Stats page (stats.html) now tracks changes in your tinnitus 'sharpness' (Q-factor) to better visualize progress.

title: Standardized Sharing
content: Every therapy module now includes a 'Share Setup' tool formatted for community forums like Tinnitus Talk and Reddit.

title: Technical Validation
content: A new interactive tutorial for the System Validation engine ensures your hardware is perfectly calibrated for clinical-grade therapy.

title: Achievement Unlocked
content: Stay motivated! Reaching Full Habituation now triggers a celebratory confetti burst and unlocks a downloadable Achievement Certificate to mark your success. This professional record should be shared with your healthcare provider as part of your clinical history.

title: v2026.05.2 - Engine Stability Update
content: New background Audio Engine Watchdog that detects and automatically recovers from browser-induced audio stalls.

title: v2026.05.0 - Major AI Integration
content: Integrated 5 new AI-driven tools for crisis support, personalized soundscapes, pattern analysis, TRT education, and clinical report summaries.

title: v2026.04.4 - Interactive Tutorials
content: Added voice-narrated UI walkthroughs and visual highlights for every therapy and tool.
